$comment: Canonical capability vocabulary. Repository names never appear here - this file is the Capability-first layer. 'aliases' drive goal decomposition (ja + en).

capabilities.name: Visual Design
capabilities.description: Produce and critique layout, typography, colour and visual hierarchy decisions.

capabilities.name: Frontend Implementation
capabilities.description: Write and modify HTML/CSS/JS or component-framework code for a web UI.

capabilities.name: Responsive Design
capabilities.description: Make a UI correct across viewport sizes and input modalities.

capabilities.name: Accessibility Audit
capabilities.description: Detect WCAG / ARIA violations on a rendered page and report actionable fixes.

capabilities.name: Browser Automation
capabilities.description: Drive a real browser programmatically: navigate, interact, evaluate, and read page state.

capabilities.name: Screenshot Capture
capabilities.description: Capture deterministic page or element screenshots at defined viewports.

capabilities.name: Image Comparison
capabilities.description: Diff two images pixel-wise or perceptually and produce a pass/fail with a diff artifact.

capabilities.name: Visual Regression Testing
capabilities.description: Detect unintended visual change between a baseline and the current build.
aliases: ビジュアルリグレッション

capabilities.name: Visual Review
capabilities.description: Judge a rendered UI against design intent and report concrete defects.

capabilities.name: Performance Audit
capabilities.description: Measure loading and runtime performance metrics for a page and report regressions.

capabilities.name: Testing
capabilities.description: Define and execute automated tests, and report pass/fail with reproducible output.

capabilities.name: Security Review
capabilities.description: Inspect code or configuration for security defects and unsafe operations.

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Review a diff for correctness, maintainability and convention adherence.

capabilities.name: Capability Orchestration
capabilities.description: Route a goal to the right capability, sequence capabilities, and fall back when one is unavailable.
aliases: オーケストレーション

capabilities.name: Evidence Tracking
capabilities.description: Record what was actually verified versus merely claimed, per capability.

relations.note: A screenshot of a rendered page needs a driven browser.
Automated WCAG checks run against a rendered DOM.
The three together make automated visual regression possible.
Machine-checkable page facts make a visual review evidence-based rather than impressionistic.

goalArchetypes.description: A goal about producing a web site or web UI at production quality.
goalArchetypes.rationale: 'Quality' for a web artifact is not a single capability. Shipping a page at production quality means designing it, implementing it responsively, and then proving it against a11y, performance and visual criteria. This archetype makes that expansion explicit and auditable instead of leaving it to the model's mood; the matched archetype is recorded on the GoalSpec so the user can reject it.

goalArchetypes.description: A goal about reviewing or hardening existing code rather than producing a UI.
goalArchetypes.rationale: A review goal needs a reviewer, a way to run the tests it cites, and a security pass; anything visual is out of scope unless the user says otherwise.
